patch_description: Construct the slot-to-item permutation directly during greedy packing instead of first constructing its inverse and immediately materializing the inverse with a second full-tensor scatter. The scheduler already computes each selected physical slot, so writing the selected item at that slot removes one permutation-sized allocation and scatter from both group and GPU placement stages. This preserves deterministic LPT placement, fixed per-pack capacity, and the subsequent refinement behavior while reducing planner overhead.
